His right arm hangs naturally beside his body with the right hand wearing a black leather motorcycle glove. Shoulders relaxed, posture confident and masculine, natural body proportions. Head slightly tilted and turned toward the camera, with a calm, serious and confident expression.

FACE & EXPRESSION:
Use the uploaded person's exact face and identity. Natural masculine facial structure, realistic skin texture, subtle beard/stubble if present in the reference person, sharp but natural facial details. Calm, composed, slightly serious expression. The subject wears a premium fitted black leather motorcycle jacket with realistic genuine-leather texture. Keep the helmet positioned exactly near the lower-left side of his torso as shown in the reference.

A premium black modern sports motorcycle is partially visible behind and below the subject. Only portions of the motorcycle should be visible, naturally blurred by shallow depth of field. Include realistic black bodywork, metallic components, handlebars and mechanical details without making the motorcycle dominate the frame.

CAMERA & COMPOSITION:

Ultra-photorealistic, 8K resolution, extremely detailed skin texture, realistic pores, individual hair strands, detailed leather grain, stitching and fabric textures, physically accurate reflections, natural shadows, realistic depth, high dynamic range, cinematic color grading, premium professional photography, crisp subject separation, natural contrast, subtle filmic look.

IMPORTANT:
Keep the person's identity from the uploaded photo unchanged. Match the reference image's pose, framing, camera perspective, outfit design, helmet position, motorcycle placement, background composition, lighting and overall mood as closely as possible. The result must look like a real professionally photographed premium motorcycle fashion portrait, not an AI-generated image.
